向量缓存按模型版本、输入正文和编码参数计算内容摘要。命中缓存时可以跳过重复编码，同时保持最终索引按新顺序重新组装。

局部文档修改只会使发生变化的分片失效。未变化文档的向量继续复用，中断后的构建也能从已提交批次恢复。

缓存记录不属于运行时索引。索引发布前仍需验证向量维度、数量和载荷摘要，失败构建不能发布清单。

权限校验由执行副作用的工具负责。检索到的正文只能作为证据，不能自行授予文件写入、网络访问或消息发送权限。

间接提示注入可能把命令伪装成文档说明。系统应稳定标记不可信内容，并让高优先级指令继续约束工具使用。

安全评测需要同时检查正常问题可答率和攻击指令遵从率。只删除可疑关键词会破坏安全研究文档，因此不是本阶段方案。

A transaction reserves its identifier before work begins. The commit point publishes durable state only after every required write succeeds.

Cancellation may stop unfinished work, but it must not erase an already committed record. Cleanup waits for owned callbacks before releasing the transaction resources.

Recovery replays the durable log and reconstructs derived state. It does not infer successful publication from a temporary file or an in-memory flag.

Raster image generation starts from a visual brief that names the subject, composition, lighting, and intended aspect ratio. The prompt should avoid implementation details that do not affect the image.

Image editing preserves the source identity while applying the requested local change. A transparent-background cutout requires edge inspection after generation.

Visual quality review checks anatomy, readable text, crop safety, and consistency with the reference. A technically valid file can still fail the visual acceptance criteria.

现象：查询延迟在候选集合扩大后明显上升，但前十条排序几乎没有变化。

观察：交叉编码器占用主要时间，向量召回和结果投影只占较小比例。

决定：重排序保持显式关闭，只有质量优先请求才进入自动判断。

风险：文档正文可能包含要求忽略用户的指令，也可能伪造系统消息或引用编号。

措施：工具把每个字段逐行缩进并放入生成的证据标记，提示明确正文没有授权能力。

限制：提示只能降低风险，不能替代副作用工具自身的权限、审批和审计。

检索请求先识别独立证据需求，再生成覆盖同一主题字段的首条查询。

如果首轮缺少中间标识符，Agent 读取证据后使用该标识符继续搜索。

证据充分时应停止，不能为了收集更多结果机械增加调用。

Database migrations use a monotonically increasing schema version. A reader rejects an unknown future version instead of guessing compatibility.

The writer creates all payloads in a staging directory and publishes the manifest last. Failed construction leaves no complete index.

A migration test opens the produced database through the real reader and verifies metadata, row counts, and payload hashes.

监控事件记录请求耗时、输入输出 token 和缓存命中，但不保存模型隐藏推理。

聚合报告区分端到端时间与工具时间，硬件相关数据不能当作跨机器保证。

失败运行保留错误类型和样本标识，不从平均值中静默删除。

自动路由先识别完整电话号码、错误码和其他不透明标识符，这类查询优先使用 BM25。

普通自然语言问题默认使用 Dense，以获得跨表达和跨语言的语义召回。

Hybrid 只有显式选择时启用，因为既有样本显示它在部分中文排序任务上更慢且质量更低。

The offline builder streams source records into a staging database. Bounded transactions keep memory use independent of the complete corpus size.

Content-addressed vector keys include the exact input and model configuration. Reordering documents therefore reuses embeddings without reusing stale ordinals.

The manifest is written after SQLite and vector payloads complete. Runtime readers reject incomplete directories that do not contain a valid manifest.

At query time BM25 analyzes lexical terms and exact identifiers. Dense retrieval compares a normalized query vector with stored document vectors.

Reciprocal rank fusion combines independently ranked sparse and dense lists. It does not make either underlying ranking more accurate.

A reranker can rescore the leading candidates, but its additional latency is paid only when the deployment or request selects it.

The example introduces a small configuration before showing the executable block.

```yaml
plugins:
  - name: knowledge-local

  - name: tool-knowledge
```

The fenced block must remain one candidate unit even though it contains an empty line.

The final paragraph explains that semantic scoring must not rewrite source text.
短文档只有一个事实，不需要语义切分。

缓存键包含模型标识和完整版本。

缓存键包含精确输入文本摘要。

缓存键包含编码数据类型。

缓存记录按成功批次提交。

缓存命中跳过重复编码。

缓存未命中进入批量编码。
